validated_results.title: Prostate cancer susceptibility is mediated by interactions between exposure to ultraviolet radiation and polymorphisms in the 5' haplotype block of the vitamin D receptor gene.
validated_results.reason: The study evaluates vitamin D receptor gene SNPs and haplotypes in interaction with ultraviolet radiation exposure rather than a population-wide vitamin D nutritional exposure effect.

validated_results.title: [Vitamin D and cancer].
validated_results.reason: The article explicitly states "In this review, we summarize the epidemiological, animal and clinical research of vitamin D", making it a narrative review rather than original human research.

validated_results.title: Conditional expression of human 15-lipoxygenase-1 in mouse prostate induces prostatic intraepithelial neoplasia: the FLiMP mouse model.
validated_results.reason: This is a genetically engineered mouse model study of 15-lipoxygenase-1 overexpression with no human dietary PUFA exposure data.

validated_results.title: Nutraceutical inhibitors of urokinase: potential applications in prostate cancer prevention and treatment.
validated_results.reason: The work is a computational docking and in vitro cell-culture screen of nutraceutical urokinase inhibitors without any human incidence data.

validated_results.title: Nutraceutical inhibitors of urokinase: potential applications in prostate cancer prevention and treatment.
validated_results.reason: Folic acid appears only as a candidate urokinase inhibitor identified in a preclinical database/in vitro screen, with no human prostate cancer incidence analysis.

validated_results.title: [Case-control study of the genes of receptors of the androgens of vitamin-D and of 5-alphareductase in a population of Afro-Caribbean population with prostate cancer].
validated_results.journal: Progres en urologie : journal de l'Association francaise d'urologie et de la Societe francaise d'urologie
validated_results.reason: The case-control study assesses vitamin D receptor, androgen receptor, and 5-alpha-reductase gene polymorphisms rather than any measured vitamin D nutritional exposure.

validated_results.title: Hemolysate thioredoxin reductase and glutathione peroxidase activities correlate with serum selenium in a group of New Zealand men at high prostate cancer risk.
validated_results.reason: The trial reports correlations between serum selenium and selenoenzyme activities in high-risk men, with no prostate cancer incidence results presented.

validated_results.title: Vitamin D compounds: clinical development as cancer therapy and prevention agents.
validated_results.reason: The article is a narrative review of preclinical and clinical development of calcitriol and vitamin D analogs as cancer therapy agents, not an original incidence study.
